author: Evan Edinger
description:
How long will Britain's cycling capital hold the crown? 
Big thanks to the folks at Balfe's Bikes for helping make this video happen. If you need a bike or advice, hit them up! https://bit.ly/4xsP6We

Thank you so much for watching! Hope you enjoyed it!

Hey there description reader! So a little extra info on this one. I've been wanting to see what it was like cycling in Britain's cycling capital for ages. I was also looking to get a folding ebike for this video's sequel (teased at the end), so I reached out to Balfe's Bikes to see if they could help me as that was the shop I'd always end up popping by for advice and such. I was super thankful the brand liked my idea for this video, and literally asked for NO input at all. Just let me do my thing. I've really been loving my Tern Vektron P5i since I got it, and it's the one thing that made the sequel and more upcoming videos possible! I might be uploading a review of it on the second channel at some point soon if anyone's interested in
title: I Cycled Britain’s Two Best Cycling Cities. One Surprised Me.
